item.description: By MEGAN HUGHES news@yourdailyglobe.com IRONWOOD — The Board of Education for Ironwood Area Schools voted on Monday to move school servers to a virtual server hosted by the Regional Educational Media Center Association of Michigan. item.title: The Globe wins 12 Wisconsin awards
item.description: IRONWOOD - The Wisconsin Newspaper Association has reported that its judges granted 12 awards to The Globe for entries in the 2025 Better Newspaper Contest. Five were first-place awards.
